paragraphs: MuniLogic sells municipal management software to local governments in the United States. Its main product, MuniLogic CE+, is municipal management software for small to mid-sized local governments, built from integrated modules. MuniCitizen, an extension of that product, offers citizens online access to licenses, permits, updates and events.

Alongside the software, the company lists consulting services covering GIS, digital transformation, CIOaaS and custom solutions development. The about page says the company works with municipalities, counties, townships, boroughs, and cities to create digital solutions. MuniLogic is described there as a division of INVORG.

One case study covers the Central Keystone Council of Governments, a collective of central Pennsylvania municipalities. That study reports faster processing for permits and licenses. It also reports that the move to digital reduced paper usage.

quote.text: Digitally transforming small to mid-sized local governments in the USA
